thought.title: fp16 direct compute with Exp-based SiLU and larger chunk
thought.description: Replaced fp32 intermediate computation with fp16 direct compute. Eliminated 2 Cast ops per chunk (half→float and float→half). Used Exp-based SiLU: val/(1+exp(-val)) instead of tanh-based sigmoid approximation. Increased vector chunk size from 64 to 256 for better vector unit utilization. Workspace buffers now use half dtype instead of float, reducing memory footprint.
thought.reason: For memory-bound element-wise operators, data type conversions between fp16 and fp32 add significant overhead. Computing directly in fp16 eliminates this overhead. The Exp-based sigmoid uses 4 ops (Muls+Exp+Adds+Div) vs tanh-based 5 ops (Muls+Tanh+Adds+Muls+Mul). Larger chunk size (256 vs 64) improves vector unit utilization.
thought.target_bottleneck: fp32 cast overhead in memory-bound element-wise kernel

runtime.dsl_before: Cast half→float. Tanh-based sigmoid: Muls(0.5)+Tanh+Adds(1)+Muls(0.5)+Mul+Mul. Chunk size 64. Cast float→half. Workspace buffers use float dtype.
runtime.dsl_after: Fp16 direct compute. Exp-based SiLU: Muls(-1)+Exp+Adds(1)+Div+Mul. Chunk size 256. Eliminated Cast(half→float) and Cast(float→half). Workspace buffers use half dtype.
